Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: A mix of publicly available data, licensed data, and information from Meta's products and services (including publicly shared posts from Instagram and Facebook and people's interactions with Meta AI).
quotes: Llama 4 Scout was pretrained on ~40 trillion tokens and Llama 4 Maverick was pretrained on ~22 trillion tokens of multimodal data from a mix of publicly available, licensed data and information from Meta’s products and services. This includes publicly shared posts from Instagram and Facebook and people’s interactions with Meta AI.
